info.title: bonYe customer mobile API
info.description: Server-owned central accounts, pets, points, credit, stock and operations. WooCommerce cart/payment; WordPress public content. JSON /api/v1. No database, SMS or Woo secrets in Flutter. All timestamps UTC RFC3339; calendar dates Gregorian. Legacy enums retain central Persian stored values. Unconfigured services fail closed.

post.summary: Calculate reviewed healthy adult estimated range
post.description: Gated by veterinary review. AAHA 2021 RER=70*kg^0.75, original factor ranges. Real complete adult kcal/kg required. Young/senior, special conditions and non-normal assessment receive no dose. Meals are user-selected. Conservative adulthood gate: dogs 24 months, cats 12 months; product policy, not biological claim.
